title: Coordination of Heterogeneous Teams with Uncertain Task Requirements
abstract: arXiv:2611.21828v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Coordinating a team of heterogeneous agents to complete tasks with unknown requirements is a challenging multi-agent planning problem. Agents differ in their ability to discover task requirements and in their ability to engage tasks, so the planner must coordinate task discovery, execution, and staging. This paper introduces a hierarchical planner that uses a graph neural network policy to assign actions to agents, then finds a path to the action's location using a shortest-path algorithm. The central part of our approach is the CAAT graph, which is a graph representation of the planning context consisting of the agents, tasks, capabilities, and actions. We demonstrate that our learned planner can jointly coordinate a heterogeneous team to simultaneously discover task requirements and complete tasks in a shorter time compared to baselines that optimize task discovery and task engagement independently. translated_title: 具有不确定性任务需求的异构团队协调
translated_abstract: 协调一组异构智能体来完成需求未知的任务是一个具有挑战性的多智能体规划问题。智能体在发现任务需求的能力和执行任务的能力上存在差异，因此规划器必须协调任务发现、执行与调度。本文提出了一种分层规划器，该规划器使用图神经网络策略为智能体分配动作，然后利用最短路径算法寻找通往动作位置的路径。我们方法的核心是CAAT图，它是对由智能体、任务、能力和动作组成的规划上下文的图表示。我们证明了所提出的学习型规划器能够联合协调异构团队，在发现任务需求的同时完成任务，且相比独立优化任务发现与任务执行的基线方法耗时更短。此外，我们展示了我们的策略……
tldr: 本文提出了基于CAAT图表示和图神经网络策略的分层规划器，能够联合协调异构智能体团队同时进行任务需求发现与任务执行，比独立优化两者的基线方法更快地完成任务。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a hierarchical planner based on a CAAT graph representation and a graph neural network policy that jointly coordinates heterogeneous agent teams to simultaneously discover task requirements and complete tasks, outperforming baselines that optimize discovery and engagement independently.
